sources.title: The Rise of the Software-Defined Vehicle: Architectures, Enabling Technologies, and Future Opportunities
sources.role: Author arXiv paper/preprint used to verify the architecture, evaluation scope, material claims, and limitations available in the primary text.

claims.text: The survey organizes SDV technologies into functional hardware, E/E architectures, software frameworks, automation mechanisms, and distributed infrastructure domains.
It surveys the progression from distributed ECUs to domain, zonal and centralized computing architectures alongside SOA/middleware, automation pipelines and cloud infrastructure.
The survey highlights cybersecurity, interoperability, data management and scalability as cross-cutting SDV challenges.

limitations.text: This is a broad survey rather than primary empirical validation of any one architecture mechanism.
The accessible primary abstract does not expose search methodology, source-selection criteria, study count, evidence-quality assessment, or threats to validity.

targets.target: Verify the architecture, evaluation setup, material claims and limitations reported for The Rise of the Software-Defined Vehicle: Architectures, Enabling Technologies, and Future Opportunities; preserve paper results as AUTHOR_CLAIM unless independently established.
targets.finding: The primary abstract verifies the survey taxonomy, architecture progression and challenge categories, but review methodology and evidence-selection rigor are not visible in the accessible primary text.

unresolved_questions: Inspect the full survey methodology/source corpus before using it as systematic evidence rather than contextual synthesis.

editorial.why_now_note: Its broad taxonomy spans all six Automotive experiment lanes and can help check coverage completeness at the end of Evidence intake.
editorial.rationale: Useful framing/coverage-check source, but primary standards, implementation sources and focused studies should carry specific report claims.
